paragraphs: Tavi, slave of Rabban Gamliel of Yavneh; see there. Gilgulei Neshamot (ג״נ), Chet 6, writes that he is Ham: Tavi and Ham have the same reduced numerical value, and Ham is “a slave of slaves.” Bereshit Rabbah says they had many slaves worthy of ordination, like Tavi, Rabban Gamliel's slave. See there, letter chet.
